# 3 bed detached house for sale

> 3 BED DETACHED BUNGALOW WITH EQUESTRIAN FACILITIES Savills is delighted to present Dun Saoibhe, a beautifully maintained three bedroomed detached bungalow situated on an impressive site of around 3.8 acres that combines comfortable family living with excellent equestrian facilities.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 171 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C1
- Lokalita: Dun Saoibhe, Ahadallane, Donoughmore
- Cena: 595 000 €
